title: Easy
subtitle: 「容易的／簡單的／輕鬆的」，要分清到底是『不複雜』、『不費力』、『可應付』、『容易使用』，還是『整個過程很順利』。
description: 「容易的／簡單的／輕鬆的」，要分清到底是『不複雜』、『不費力』、『可應付』、『容易使用』，還是『整個過程很順利』。

words.meaning: 簡單的；容易理解／完成的
words.example: The instructions are simple enough for beginners to follow.
words.exampleZh: 這些指示很簡單，初學者也能跟從。

exercises.original: The instructions are easy for beginners to follow.
exercises.zh: 這些指示對初學者來說很容易理解。
exercises.upgrade: The instructions are simple enough for beginners to follow.

options.explanation: instructions + beginners 表示內容不複雜、容易理解，simple 最自然。
basic 只表示基礎程度，基礎指示仍可能寫得難懂。
quick 表示所需時間短，不表示理解難度低。
small 只描述尺寸／範圍。
obvious 表示一眼可見，不等於步驟本身簡單。
comfortable 是舒適感，不描述指示結構。

exercises.original: The problem has an easy solution.
exercises.zh: 這個問題有一個簡單的解決方法。
exercises.upgrade: The problem has a simple solution.

options.explanation: solution 若不複雜、步驟少，simple 是最自然的改寫。
quick 只表示解決得快，未必結構簡單。
basic only 可能指初階，但不能保證適合問題。
small 不適合 solution 的難度。
comfortable 不能形容解決方法的難度。
obvious solution 是一眼看出的答案，語義比 simple 更窄。

exercises.original: The task is easy because it has only two steps.
exercises.zh: 這項任務很簡單，因為只有兩個步驟。
exercises.upgrade: The task is simple because it has only two steps.

options.explanation: only two steps 明確把容易歸因於結構簡單。
quick 可能結果上很快，但原句強調步驟少。
comfortable 不描述任務結構。
obvious 不表示步驟少。
small 可以形容規模，但不直接表示難度。
effortless necessarily 太強；兩步任務仍可能需要一些注意力。

words.example: The new interface makes switching between accounts almost effortless.
words.exampleZh: 新介面令切換帳戶幾乎毫不費力。

exercises.original: The new interface makes switching accounts very easy.
exercises.zh: 新介面令切換帳戶變得非常輕鬆。
exercises.upgrade: The new interface makes switching accounts almost effortless.

options.explanation: makes switching almost no effort 是 effortless 的核心。
basic 描述初階程度，不描述操作所需努力。
quick 可以很快但仍需複雜操作。
small 不適用操作難度。
obvious 只表示看得出方法。
comfortable 偏舒適，不等於操作幾乎不費力。

exercises.original: She made the difficult movement look easy.
exercises.zh: 她把這個高難度動作做得看來毫不費力。
exercises.upgrade: She made the difficult movement look effortless.

options.explanation: look easy despite being difficult 是典型 effortless performance 語境。
simple 會誤解成動作本身結構簡單。
basic 與 difficult movement 明顯不合。
quick 只描述速度。
comfortable 不一定表示技術動作毫不費力。
obvious 不能形容動作執行的輕鬆感。

exercises.original: Automation made the repetitive task much easier.
exercises.zh: 自動化令重複工作變得幾乎不費力。
exercises.upgrade: Automation made the repetitive task almost effortless.

options.explanation: automation reduces human effort，almost effortless 最能表達省力。
quick 可能縮短時間，但不必然減少所有努力。
basic 只是難度層級。
comfortable 不是工作負荷概念。
obvious 不表示省力。
small 不描述工作所需精力。

words.meaning: 直接簡單的；易明的；不複雜的
words.example: The application process is straightforward and takes only a few minutes.
words.exampleZh: 申請程序簡單直接，只需幾分鐘。

exercises.original: The application process is easy and takes only a few minutes.
exercises.zh: 申請程序簡單直接，只需幾分鐘。
exercises.upgrade: The application process is straightforward and takes only a few minutes.

options.explanation: process + few complications 表示步驟清楚、直接，straightforward 最自然。
quick only 只說時間短，不能涵蓋程序不複雜。
basic 通常描述程度／內容層級。
obvious 不適合整個申請程序。
comfortable 不描述行政程序難度。
small 不適用程序結構。

exercises.original: The calculation is easy once the formula is known.
exercises.zh: 知道公式後，計算便很直接簡單。
exercises.upgrade: The calculation is straightforward once the formula is known.

options.explanation: once formula is known 表示程序清楚、沒有複雜步驟。
obvious 會表示答案一眼可見，並非只是計算容易。
quick 未必；計算可 straightforward 但仍需時間。
comfortable 不適用。
small 不描述計算方法。
basic only 不足以表達操作上沒有複雜性。

exercises.original: The procedure is easy to explain to new staff.
exercises.zh: 這項程序很簡單直接，容易向新員工解釋。
exercises.upgrade: The procedure is straightforward to explain to new staff.

options.explanation: procedure being easy to explain 通常因為結構直接、不繁複。
quick 只表示解釋速度。
obvious 不等於可清楚解釋。
comfortable 不描述程序。
basic 只說層級較初階。
small 不表示流程簡潔。

words.example: The booking system is uncomplicated and easy to learn.
words.exampleZh: 預約系統並不複雜，而且很容易學會。

exercises.original: The booking system is easy and has very few steps.
exercises.zh: 預約系統不複雜，步驟很少。
exercises.upgrade: The booking system is uncomplicated and has very few steps.

options.explanation: very few steps 直接支持『沒有複雜環節』。
quick 只表示速度。
small 不描述系統結構。
obvious 不等於沒有複雜條件。
comfortable 不適合系統複雜度。
basic 可能描述功能簡單，但不必然等於使用流程 uncomplicated。

exercises.original: The arrangement is easy because there are no special conditions.
exercises.zh: 安排很簡單，因為沒有特別條件。
exercises.upgrade: The arrangement is uncomplicated because there are no special conditions.

options.explanation: no special conditions 是 uncomplicated 的明確線索。
obvious 只表示容易看出。
quick 不表示條件少。
comfortable 不描述安排結構。
small 不適用。
effortless 強調不用努力，原句只說條件不複雜。

exercises.original: The design is easy to understand because it avoids unnecessary features.
exercises.zh: 設計避免多餘功能，所以很容易理解。
exercises.upgrade: The design is uncomplicated because it avoids unnecessary features.

options.explanation: avoids unnecessary features 表示設計刻意保持不複雜。
basic 可能意味功能少，但不一定是因避免多餘複雜。
quick 不適用設計理解。
obvious 不是同一概念。
comfortable 不適用。
small 只描述尺寸／規模。

words.example: The project is challenging, but the workload is manageable.
words.exampleZh: 這個項目有挑戰性，但工作量仍可應付。

exercises.original: The workload is not easy, but it is still possible to handle.
exercises.zh: 工作量並不容易，但仍然可以應付。
exercises.upgrade: The workload is not easy, but it is manageable.

options.explanation: not easy but possible to handle 正是 manageable 的核心。
effortless 與 not easy 明顯矛盾。
simple 會低估實際難度。
obvious 不適合工作量。
comfortable 不等於可應付。
basic 不描述工作量是否能完成。

exercises.original: Breaking the project into stages made it easier to handle.
exercises.zh: 把項目分成幾個階段後，便較容易應付。
exercises.upgrade: Breaking the project into stages made it more manageable.

options.explanation: breaking into stages reduces burden，使整體變得可應付。
simple necessarily 不保證項目本身變簡單，只是更容易管理。
effortless 太強。
obvious 不符項目工作量。
quick 不代表較可管理。
comfortable 不描述管理難度。

exercises.original: The monthly payment is easy enough for most families to cope with.
exercises.zh: 每月付款額對大部分家庭而言仍可應付。
exercises.upgrade: The monthly payment is manageable for most families.

options.explanation: payment + cope with 表示負擔在可承受範圍。
effortless 不適合財務負擔。
basic 不描述負擔能力。
obvious 不符。
quick 不相關。
small only 未必；金額可能不小但仍 manageable。

words.example: The warm-up exercise is deliberately undemanding.
words.exampleZh: 這項熱身練習刻意設計得要求不高。

exercises.original: The warm-up exercise is deliberately easy.
exercises.zh: 這項熱身練習刻意設計得要求不高。
exercises.upgrade: The warm-up exercise is deliberately undemanding.

options.explanation: warm-up + deliberately easy 表示刻意降低技能／體能要求。
effortless necessarily 太強，熱身仍需要活動。
obvious 不描述運動要求。
quick 只說時間短。
comfortable 可能相關，但不等於要求低。
small 不描述難度。

exercises.original: The job is fairly easy and does not require much concentration.
exercises.zh: 工作相當輕鬆，不需要太多專注力。
exercises.upgrade: The job is fairly undemanding and does not require much concentration.

options.explanation: does not require much concentration 直接支持 undemanding。
simple only 可能程序簡單，但不能表達低專注要求。
quick 不代表工作輕鬆。
obvious 不適合工作。
comfortable 是感受，不是工作要求。
effortless 比 fairly easy 強得多。

exercises.original: The reading exercise is easy enough for a relaxed lesson.
exercises.zh: 這項閱讀練習要求不高，適合輕鬆課堂。
exercises.upgrade: The reading exercise is undemanding enough for a relaxed lesson.

options.explanation: relaxed lesson + low challenge 表示要求不高。
basic necessarily 只描述程度層級，不必然代表閱讀負荷低。
obvious 不符。
quick 不表示認知要求。
comfortable 不自然形容 exercise 難度。
effortless 太絕對。

words.meaning: 輕鬆無痛苦的；不麻煩的
words.example: The software update was quick and painless.
words.exampleZh: 軟件更新既快又不麻煩。

exercises.original: The software update was easy and caused no problems.
exercises.zh: 軟件更新很順利，沒有造成麻煩。
exercises.upgrade: The software update was quick and painless.

options.explanation: caused no problems 指過程幾乎沒有麻煩，painless 很自然。
simple 只說結構不複雜，未必沒有問題。
obvious 不適用更新過程。
basic 不符。
comfortable 偏身體／心理舒適。
small 不描述更新體驗。

exercises.original: Moving the data to the new system was easier than expected.
exercises.zh: 把資料移到新系統比預期更順利輕鬆。
exercises.upgrade: Moving the data to the new system was relatively painless.

options.explanation: migration + easier than expected 常用 relatively painless 表示少麻煩。
quick only 只說速度，不保證沒有問題。
basic 不描述遷移過程。
obvious 不符。
comfortable 不是系統遷移的典型詞。
small 不符。

exercises.original: The transition was easy because users kept all their settings.
exercises.zh: 轉換過程很輕鬆，因為使用者保留所有設定。
exercises.upgrade: The transition was painless because users kept all their settings.

options.explanation: keeping settings removes inconvenience, 所以 painless 精準。
simple only 不一定表達轉換沒有麻煩／損失。
quick 不是重點。
obvious 不適合 transition。
comfortable 不自然。
basic 不符。

words.meaning: 容易使用的；對使用者友善的
words.example: The redesigned website is much more user-friendly.
words.exampleZh: 重新設計的網站容易使用得多。

exercises.original: The redesigned website is much easier to use.
exercises.zh: 重新設計的網站容易使用得多。
exercises.upgrade: The redesigned website is much more user-friendly.

options.explanation: website + easier to use 是 user-friendly 的直接定義。
basic 只表示功能／內容較初階。
quick 可能載入快但不一定容易使用。
obvious 不能完整描述介面體驗。
comfortable 不是網站可用性術語。
small 不相關。

exercises.original: The new app is easy even for first-time users.
exercises.zh: 新應用程式連首次使用者也覺得容易使用。
exercises.upgrade: The new app is user-friendly even for first-time users.

options.explanation: first-time users + easy to operate 是典型 usability 語境。
simple only 可能功能少，但不一定設計得好用。
quick 只說速度。
obvious 不是整體使用體驗。
comfortable 不自然。
basic 會暗示功能層級，而非易用性。

exercises.original: The form should be easy for the public to complete online.
exercises.zh: 表格應方便公眾在網上填寫。
exercises.upgrade: The online form should be user-friendly for the public.

options.explanation: public + online form + ease of completion 指向 usability。
quick 只表示完成時間短。
basic 不表示欄位設計易用。
obvious 不足以描述整體表格。
comfortable 不適合。
small 不相關。

words.meaning: 易懂的；易於使用／接觸的
words.example: The guide explains the topic in clear, accessible language.
words.exampleZh: 指南用清晰易懂的語言解釋這個題目。

exercises.original: The guide explains the topic in easy language.
exercises.zh: 指南用容易理解的語言解釋題目。
exercises.upgrade: The guide explains the topic in accessible language.

options.explanation: language + easy to understand 是 accessible 的自然教育用法。
basic 只說程度初階，不一定寫得清楚。
quick 不適合 language。
obvious 不表示表達方式易懂。
comfortable 不描述文字理解。
small 不符。

exercises.original: The article makes a difficult subject easy for non-specialists.
exercises.zh: 文章令非專業人士也容易理解這個艱深主題。
exercises.upgrade: The article makes a difficult subject accessible to non-specialists.

options.explanation: to non-specialists 表示降低理解門檻，accessible 最精準。
simple 會說主題本身簡單，與 difficult subject 矛盾。
obvious 不代表經解釋後可理解。
quick 不符。
comfortable 不適合知識理解。
basic 只描述層級。

exercises.original: The training materials should be easy to understand for all staff.
exercises.zh: 培訓材料應讓所有員工都容易理解。
exercises.upgrade: The training materials should be accessible to all staff.

options.explanation: all staff + easy to understand 指理解門檻低。
basic 不保證所有員工都理解。
quick 不描述理解性。
small 不符。
obvious 太強，內容未必一眼可知。
comfortable 不適合文本理解。

words.example: The device is compact and easy to use.
words.exampleZh: 這部裝置體積小，而且容易使用。

exercises.original: The device is compact and easy.
exercises.zh: 這部裝置體積小，而且容易使用。
exercises.upgrade: The device is compact and easy to use.

options.explanation: device 的 easy sense 是操作容易，直接展開為 easy to use 最自然。
basic 可能表示功能較少，不等於操作方便。
quick 只描述速度。
obvious 不適合裝置操作。
comfortable 可描述握持感，但不是易用性。
small 已由 compact 表達，不能取代 easy。

exercises.original: The tool is easy even for people with little technical experience.
exercises.zh: 這個工具即使對技術經驗不多的人也很容易使用。
exercises.upgrade: The tool is easy to use even for people with little technical experience.

options.explanation: little technical experience 直接指操作門檻低。
basic 是程度／功能，不是 usability。
quick 不代表易學易用。
obvious 不等於操作簡單。
comfortable 不符工具學習。
small 不相關。

exercises.original: The controls are easy and clearly labelled.
exercises.zh: 控制按鈕容易使用，而且標示清楚。
exercises.upgrade: The controls are easy to use and clearly labelled.

options.explanation: controls + clearly labelled 表示操作難度低。
basic 不能描述實際操作。
obvious 只表示可看出用途，未必好操作。
quick 不符。
comfortable 不適合控制介面。
small 不表示易用。

words.exampleZh: 安裝過程完全沒有麻煩。

exercises.original: The installation was easy and no errors occurred.
exercises.zh: 安裝過程很順利，沒有出現錯誤。
exercises.upgrade: The installation was completely trouble-free.

options.explanation: no errors occurred 直接支持 trouble-free。
simple 只表示步驟不複雜，仍可能出錯。
basic 不描述安裝結果。
quick 只表示速度。
obvious 不適合 installation。
comfortable 不適合技術過程。

exercises.original: The journey was easy with no delays or problems.
exercises.zh: 旅程沒有延誤或問題，十分順利。
exercises.upgrade: The journey was trouble-free, with no delays or problems.

options.explanation: no delays or problems 是 trouble-free 的直接定義。
quick 可以很快但仍有麻煩。
simple 不自然描述整段旅程。
basic 不符。
comfortable 只表示舒適程度。
obvious 不符。

exercises.original: The system has been easy to operate for the past year, with almost no faults.
exercises.zh: 系統過去一年運作順利，幾乎沒有故障。
exercises.upgrade: The system has provided trouble-free operation for the past year.

options.explanation: almost no faults + operation 表示長期沒有問題。
simple 只描述複雜度。
quick 不表示穩定可靠。
basic 不符。
obvious 不描述運作可靠性。
comfortable 不適合系統運作。

words.meaning: 非常容易的事；輕而易舉
words.example: Once you know the shortcuts, editing the document is a breeze.
words.exampleZh: 一旦懂得快捷鍵，編輯文件就變得輕而易舉。

exercises.original: Once you know the shortcuts, editing the document is very easy.
exercises.zh: 懂得快捷鍵後，編輯文件就變得輕而易舉。
exercises.upgrade: Once you know the shortcuts, editing the document is a breeze.

options.explanation: very easy + informal context 很適合 a breeze。
basic 不表示做起來輕鬆。
obvious 不等於容易完成。
comfortable 不自然。
quick only 只說速度。
small 不描述任務難度。

exercises.original: The test was easy for students who had revised.
exercises.zh: 有溫習的學生覺得測驗輕而易舉。
exercises.upgrade: The test was a breeze for students who had revised.

options.explanation: informal evaluation of a very easy test 可自然說 a breeze。
basic 只說程度，未必對學生非常容易。
quick 不等於容易。
obvious 不描述整份試卷。
comfortable 不適合考試難度。
small 不符。

exercises.original: With the template, creating the report became very easy.
exercises.zh: 有了範本後，製作報告變得輕而易舉。
exercises.upgrade: With the template, creating the report became a breeze.

options.explanation: template dramatically reduces difficulty，口語可說 became a breeze。
basic 不表示流程突然變得很容易。
obvious 不適合報告製作。
quick only 可能變快但不必然容易。
comfortable 不符。
small 不相關。

words.meaning: 一帆風順；非常順利容易
words.example: After the initial setup, the rest of the process was plain sailing.
words.exampleZh: 完成最初設定後，其餘程序便一帆風順。

exercises.original: After the initial setup, the rest of the process was easy.
exercises.zh: 完成最初設定後，其餘程序便一帆風順。
exercises.upgrade: After the initial setup, the rest of the process was plain sailing.

options.explanation: after initial obstacle + rest of process smooth 是 plain sailing 的典型語境。
simple only 只說結構不複雜，沒有『之後一路順利』的過程感。
quick 只表示速度。
obvious 不符。
comfortable 不自然描述整個程序進展。
basic 不符。

exercises.original: Once the permits were approved, the project became easy to complete.
exercises.zh: 許可獲批後，項目其餘部分便進展順利。
exercises.upgrade: Once the permits were approved, the rest of the project was plain sailing.

options.explanation: major obstacle removed + rest proceeds smoothly 正是 plain sailing。
effortless necessarily 太強；仍可能需要工作，只是沒有重大阻礙。
basic 不描述項目進展。
obvious 不符。
quick 不一定。
comfortable 不適合項目流程。

exercises.original: The first week was difficult, but after that the work was easy.
exercises.zh: 第一星期很困難，但之後工作便一帆風順。
exercises.upgrade: The first week was difficult, but after that it was plain sailing.

options.explanation: difficult first stage + smooth later progress 是此慣用語的標準情境。
simple 不能表達時間轉折後一路順利。
quick 不代表沒有問題。
obvious 不符。
comfortable 只描述感受。
basic 不表示進展順暢。

falseSynonyms.zh: 基本不等於 easy basic 表示基礎、初階或不複雜；初階內容也可能對初學者很難。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Basic describes level or complexity, not necessarily difficulty.

falseSynonyms.zh: 快不等於 easy quick 表示所需時間短；一件事可以很快但很難。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Quick concerns time; easy concerns difficulty.

falseSynonyms.zh: 小不等於 easy small 描述尺寸或規模；小任務也可以技術上很難。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Size and difficulty are different.

falseSynonyms.zh: 明顯不等於 easy obvious 表示答案／事實容易看出；完成一件事是否容易是另一問題。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Something obvious is easy to notice, not necessarily easy to do.

falseSynonyms.zh: 方便不等於 easy convenient 表示省時、省事或適合需要；方便的選項仍可能需要技巧。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Convenience and difficulty are related but not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 舒服不等於 easy comfortable 是身體／心理舒適；easy 是難度低。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Comfort does not necessarily mean low difficulty.

falseSynonyms.zh: effortless 比普通 easy 更強 effortless 暗示幾乎不需努力；普通 easy 仍可能需要一些能力和注意力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Effortless is stronger than merely easy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 easy 是形容詞；easily 是副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Easy modifies nouns or follows linking verbs; easily modifies verbs.
